description: This file defines and exports a memory runtime object implementing the MemoryPluginRuntime interface. It provides functions for managing memory search managers and resolving memory backend configurations, relying on imported functions and types from the openclaw plugin SDK.

methods.name: getMemorySearchManager
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a memory search manager based on provided parameters, returning an object with the manager and any error encountered.

methods.name: resolveMemoryBackendConfig
methods.description: Resolves and returns the memory backend configuration based on provided parameters.

methods.name: closeAllMemorySearchManagers
methods.description: Closes all active memory search managers asynchronously.
